Turn-Key Manufacturing Capabilities

Our Services

Comprehensive metal manufacturing solutions from initial prototype engineering to tight-tolerance CNC production and complete mechanical assembly.

Fabrication Division

Precision Sheet Metal Fabrication

We form, punch, and laser-cut metal to exact specifications for electronics enclosures, medical consoles, avionics chassis, and industrial equipment. Our facility combines high-power fiber laser cutting with automated turret punch presses and multi-axis CNC press brakes.

Fiber laser cutting for burr-free edges across aluminum, stainless, and copper
CNC turret punch presses with multi-tool indexing for high-speed hole patterns
Computerized press brakes with precision angle measurement for repeatable bends
MIG, TIG, and spot welding certified for high-strength cosmetic joints
Quote Sheet Metal Project
Fabrication Capabilities

High-Speed Fiber Laser

4kW cutting envelope handling sheet sizes up to 5ft x 10ft with microscopic contouring.

33-Ton Turret Punching

58-station thick turret tooling capable of forming louvers, countersinks, and knockouts.

Multi-Axis Press Brakes

Programmable 8-axis backgauges guaranteeing precision bends up to 10 feet in length.

Machining Specifications

±0.0002" Tight Tolerances

Precision dimensional accuracy maintained across critical aerospace and medical interfaces.

Multi-Axis CNC Milling

High-speed 12,000 RPM spindles with intuitive touch probing for 3D sculptured surfaces.

Live Tooling Lathes

Integrated turning and milling in a single machine setup to maximize concentricity.

CNC Machining Division

High Precision Machining

CNC machining that guarantees tight tolerances across aluminum, stainless steel, titanium, brass, and engineered plastics. We handle complex geometric features requiring true multi-axis precision and flawless surface finishing.

Multi-axis vertical machining centers with rigid thermal stabilization
CNC turning with sub-spindle live tooling for single-operation completion
Dedicated surface grinding and precision de-burring departments
Expertise in aerospace alloys (6061-T6, 7075, 304, 316, Inconel)
Quote Machining Job
Assembly & Integration

Engineering & Value-Added Assembly

Our job is not complete when parts come off the machine. Harcon Precision Metals delivers turn-key value-added assembly—including PEM hardware insertion, gasket installation, mechanical subassembly, silk-screening, and protective packaging.

Automated PEM hardware and threaded fastener insertion
Certified electrical ground stud and bracket assembly
Anodizing, powder coating, chem-film, and plating network coordination
Final mechanical assembly and custom protective packaging for direct shipping
Start Turn-Key Project
Turn-Key Finish Services

Hardware & Fastener Insertion

Pneumatic Haeger presses with autofeed bowl systems guaranteeing reliable fastener pull-out strength.

Plating & Finishing Networks

Mil-spec anodizing (Type II / Type III Hardcoat), chem film (MIL-DTL-5541), and powder coating.

Box-Build Subassembly

Kitted and fully assembled chassis delivered ready for electrical wiring and line installation.
